prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively mountain campsite scene. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands next to a tall pine tree, holding a metal ladle over a bubbling pot that sits on a portable stove. Beside him, a woman in a yellow beanie points at a map spread out on a wooden picnic table. A brown dog sits on the bench attached to the table, looking up at the woman. In the center, a boy in a blue jacket roasts a marshmallow on a stick over a crackling campfire, while a girl in pink boots watches the flames intently. Next to the fire, an older man with gray hair rests his hand on the shoulder of a child in a green hoodie who is tying their shoelaces. To the right, a teenager in headphones leans against a large orange tent, scrolling through a phone. Nearby, a black cat perches on top of a stacked pile of camping gear bags. Behind the tent, a hiker in a purple backpack walks along a dirt path, waving at a cyclist in a neon vest who rides past on the trail. A white owl rests on a low branch of a bush near the path. The sky above is clear and blue, with no clouds visible. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no car parked near the tents. The scene captures a moment of shared outdoor activity with distinct characters engaged in various campsite routines.
